# frozen_string_literal: true

require "minitest/autorun"

# Turns a human-readable title into a URL-friendly slug.
#
#   slugify("Hello, World!") #=> "hello-world"
#
# Accents are transliterated ("Crème Brûlée" => "creme-brulee"), apostrophes
# are dropped rather than turned into hyphens ("Don't Stop" => "dont-stop"),
# and any run of other punctuation/whitespace collapses to a single hyphen.
def slugify(title)
  title
    .to_s
    .unicode_normalize(:nfkd)   # decompose accented chars into base + mark
    .gsub(/\p{Mn}/, "")         # drop the combining marks: "Crème" -> "Creme"
    .downcase
    .gsub(/['’]/, "")           # contractions: "don't" -> "dont"
    .gsub(/[^a-z0-9]+/, "-")    # every run of junk becomes one hyphen
    .gsub(/\A-+|-+\z/, "")      # trim hyphens at the ends
end

class SlugifyTest < Minitest::Test
  def test_basic_title
    assert_equal "hello-world", slugify("Hello, World!")
  end

  def test_collapses_runs_of_punctuation_and_whitespace
    assert_equal "a-b-c", slugify("  A  --  B... C  ")
  end

  def test_numbers_are_kept
    assert_equal "top-10-songs-of-1999", slugify("Top 10 Songs of 1999")
  end

  def test_transliterates_accents
    assert_equal "creme-brulee", slugify("Crème Brûlée")
  end

  def test_drops_apostrophes
    assert_equal "dont-stop-me-now", slugify("Don't Stop Me Now")
  end

  def test_already_slugged_input_is_unchanged
    assert_equal "already-a-slug", slugify("already-a-slug")
  end

  def test_empty_and_punctuation_only_input
    assert_equal "", slugify("")
    assert_equal "", slugify("!!!")
    assert_equal "", slugify(nil)
  end
end
